summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of EventGudang. 20/21 pytest passed (dashboard KPI count changed 11->12 due to new item created in Penerimaan test earlier in run, not a bug). All critical flows work: JWT auth (admin/staff), dashboard KPIs, items CRUD with role guards, Excel export (admin only, 403 for staff), SJ create with SJ-YYYYMM-#### numbering + qr_token + available_qty deduction, SJ return flow with correct Baik/Rusak/Hilang/Terpakai math (Baik→+available, Rusak→+damaged, Hilang→+lost & -total, Terpakai→+used & -total), status transitions out→partial→returned, by-token lookup, Penerimaan existing (+total+available) and new modes with BARU tag, dup-SKU 400, master data CRUD (warehouses/brands/categories/users) with brand-delete-guard when items reference it, staff denied 403 on all admin endpoints. Frontend: all pages load, admin sees add/edit/delete/export buttons and Master Data sidebar section; staff correctly hidden. Data-testid coverage excellent.

minor.issue: jenis_barang counts all items including test-created ones; not a bug, just note for test seeding. Expected 11 assertion only valid on a clean DB.

issues: Uses native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar/date picker component — acceptable per spec but could be more consistent with the shadcn design system.

action_items: None critical. Optionally swap native date inputs for shadcn Calendar Popover for design consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seed() password re-hash branch runs on every startup for both admin and staff — good (allows password rotation via env). Uses bcrypt $2b$ format via bcrypt.hashpw. OK.
server.py L440 gen_sj_number uses count_documents by prefix regex — could race under concurrency (two concurrent SJ posts could get same number). Consider atomic counter collection.
server.py return flow: `total_qty` decrement for lost/used is applied via $inc negative — safe as MongoDB allows it. No lower-bound guard on total_qty.

server.py L751 CORS `allow_origins='*'` combined with `allow_credentials=True` — Starlette will silently disallow credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Backend uses Bearer header (not cookies) so this is fine in practice, but the config is contradictory; set explicit origins if cookies are ever used.
Route order in App.js correctly places `/surat-jalan/baru` before `/surat-jalan/:id` — no shadow. Good.
server.py file is ~840 lines and monolithic — consider splitting into routers/*.py by resource for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
No pagination on list endpoints (items/SJ/penerimaan use to_list(1000) / 5000). Acceptable for MVP scale but note for growth.
